# The Buggies Express
> Australia's most complete golf buggy business — sales, service, warranty, parts, and custom builds, backed by support that doesn't end at delivery.

The Buggies Express (operated by Golf Buggies Express PTY LTD, ABN 28 668 598 758, ACN 668 598 758) is a registered Australian company headquartered in Yatala QLD 4207. We supply high-performance electric golf buggies, luxury 4-seaters, lifted acreage 4x4 carts, commercial farm utilities, and genuine parts across Queensland, New South Wales, Victoria, and nation-wide Australia.

## Product Categories & Pricing
- [Luxury & High-Demand 4-Seaters](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/luxury-4-seater/): Premium 48V/72V lithium passenger buggies ($16,800 - $27,900 AUD).
- [Traditional 2-Seater Electric Golf Buggies](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/traditional-2-seater/): Course-ready 2-passenger carts with AC motors and auto-park brakes ($11,990 - $16,990 AUD).
- [Off-Road, Lifted & 4x4 Buggies](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/off-road-4x4/): Heavy-duty acreage carts with 3-4 inch factory lifts, all-terrain tyres, and 350A controllers ($17,500 - $23,800 AUD).
- [Commercial & Farm Utility Buggies](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/commercial-utility/): Flatbed and drop-side cargo vehicles with up to 680kg payload ($15,900 - $26,400 AUD).
- [Mechanical & Petrol Buggies](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/mechanical-petrol/): Yamaha QuietTech EFI and Kohler petrol carts with extended range ($13,900 - $16,800 AUD).
- [Motorised Walk-Behind Golf Buggies](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/walk-behind-buggies/): MGI Ai Navigator GPS and Robera smart follow motorized buggies ($1,299 - $2,849 AUD).
- [Batteries, Chargers & Parts](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/shop/batteries-chargers-parts/): Lithium drop-in conversion kits, smart chargers, hydraulic disc brakes, and accessories ($75 - $3,850 AUD).

- [Yatala Workshop & Service](https://www.golfbuggiesexpress.com.au/about/): Factory warranty repair, lithium battery conversions, and custom accessories.
